environment.description: EC2 c5.xlarge running Amazon Linux 2 with the legacy monolith compiled with gcc 7.3 (-O2, no sanitizers). The application serves HTML pages directly on port 8080 behind a classic ELB with no content inspection. Pages are served with Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com but no require-sri-for directive. The heap allocator is glibc 2.26 ptmalloc2 with no hardening (no MALLOC_PERTURB_, tcache enabled). Instance runs in a public subnet with security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080.
